title: DAY 35/90
THERMO
scenes.sub: A brand new subject starts today
scenes.voice: Day thirty five of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, seventy one days to go. Fluids are done. Today thermodynamics begins, one of the highest scoring subjects.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, thermodynamics. Topic, basics and pure substances. Get these definitions right, and every later chapter becomes easier.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover systems and processes, the zeroth law, work and heat, properties of pure substances and steam tables, and ideal versus real gases.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
lines: Same for h, u and s
scenes.voice: Quick tip. For wet steam, any property equals the liquid value plus dryness fraction times the change on evaporation. And compressibility factor Z equals one means ideal gas.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The practice PDF is waiting on Telegram. Test tonight, seven to nine P. M.: use the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 34 Toppers
scenes.voice: Pipe losses toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo is rank one again, with twenty three point three three. Shivam Sahu holds rank two, and Sai Avinash enters at rank three. Superb!
